numbering_iff.claim: Symbolic CNF satisfiability is equivalent to existence of a model of its numbered database.

numbered_bounds.claim: Every numbered literal ID is positive and within the declared variable bound.

checkEncoded_sound.claim: Acceptance of any decoded proof stream implies the source Boolean expression is false under every input valuation.

checkValid_sound.claim: Acceptance of a refutation of the negated expression implies the expression is true under every input valuation.

checks: Numbered versus symbolic satisfiability via enumerated auxiliary assignments.
Existing Go encoder, Lean symbolic CNF, and source expression evaluations agree.

real_solver.acceptance_path: Decode LRAT, reconstruct the target CNF from the fixture expression, invoke checkEncoded or checkValid; no DIMACS input is read by this gate.

scope.proved: Lean Boolean expressions with constants, inputs, NOT, AND, OR; finite numeric allocation; source-level soundness of RUP acceptance.
not_proved: Oak parsing, types, source semantics, and obligation construction.
Go encoder/checker refinement and optimized allocation.
Enums, arithmetic, transition-system encodings, RAT and theory lemmas.
Fixture CLI/JSON tooling and Lean compiler/runtime correctness.
scope.independent_dimacs_gate: The existing RUPCheck gate retains its separate DIMACS parsing boundary.
